hook.title: Use AI to *learn* code, not just write it
hook.cover: Use AI to learn, not just copy

scenes.before: write me a function that removes duplicates from a list
scenes.after: Write a function that removes duplicates from a list and keeps the order. Then explain each line like I'm new to Python, and tell me one way it could break.
scenes.title: Copy vs *learn*
Ask *why*, not just what
scenes.body: Code you understand is code you can fix at 2am.

scenes.title: Ask how it could *break*
scenes.body: Fastest way to find the edge cases you didn't think of.

end.title: Save this for your next *project*
end.sub: follow for daily AI + code tips

caption:
If you only ever paste what AI writes, you're stuck the moment it breaks.

Add two things to the prompt: "explain each line" and "tell me one way it could break". You get the code, you learn why it works, and you find the edge cases before they find you.

Save this for your next coding session.
